editorial:
Imagine finding an old German submarine from World War II and deciding the best use for it is to rob a giant cruise ship. That is exactly what happens here. You get a group of daring adventurers who are not exactly saints, but they are fun to watch. The whole vibe feels like those classic heist movies where the plan seems impossible, but the characters are confident they can pull it off. It is a wild ride that mixes a bit of treasure hunting with a high-stakes crime plot, making you feel like you are part of a secret club planning a massive score.

The action keeps moving and the tension builds nicely as they get closer to the Queen Mary. While some of the special effects look a bit dated now, the acting is solid and the plot twists keep you guessing. If you love old-school thrillers with a big scale, you will really dig this. It is a great pick for a weekend movie night. You should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The plan almost works, but things go south when the team faces betrayal and unexpected resistance. After a tense battle and a daring escape, most of the crew realizes that greed leads to ruin. The heist ends in chaos, and the submarine is lost. In the end, the law catches up with the survivors, proving that robbing a legendary ship with a rusty sub was probably too ambitious.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic heist movies and old warships.
